name: Banned | 200mg Treats | Chocolate Covered Pretzels
description: Banned Milk Chocolate Covered Pretzels deliver 200mg of THC in a sweet and salty edible format. Each pretzel combines smooth milk chocolate with a crunchy, savory center for a balanced flavor experience. Designed for consistent dosing and long-lasting effects, they offer a reliable and enjoyable option for consumers seeking a tasty, higher-potency edible.
